# MSHAB Dataset Structure (obs_mode="rgbdp")

Generated by `mshab/utils/gen/gen_data.py` with `obs_mode="rgbdp"`.

## HDF5 Structure

```
trajectory.h5
└── traj_0/
    ├── obs/
    │   ├── agent/
    │   │   ├── qpos: (T, D_qpos) float32
    │   │   └── qvel: (T, D_qvel) float32
    │   ├── extra/
    │   │   ├── base_pose: (T, 7) float32 - [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz]
    │   │   ├── tcp_pose_wrt_base: (T, 7) float32
    │   │   ├── obj_pose_wrt_base: (T, 7) float32
    │   │   └── ...
    │   ├── sensor_data/
    │   │   └── {camera_name}/
    │   │       ├── rgb: (T, H, W, 3) uint8 - [0, 255]
    │   │       ├── depth: (T, H, W, 1) int16 - millimeters
    │   │       ├── position: (T, H, W, 3) int16 - camera space XYZ in mm
    │   │       └── segmentation: (T, H, W, 1) int16
    │   ├── sensor_param/
    │   │   └── {camera_name}/
    │   │       ├── extrinsic_cv: (T, 4, 4) float32
    │   │       ├── cam2world_gl: (T, 4, 4) float32
    │   │       └── intrinsic_cv: (T, 3, 3) float32
    │   └── pointcloud/
    │       ├── xyzw: (T, N, 4) float32 - world XYZ + foreground flag
    │       ├── rgb: (T, N, 3) uint8 - [0, 255]
    │       ├── segmentation: (T, N, 1) int16
    │       └── xyzrgb: (T, 1024, 6) float32 - cropped & sampled
    ├── actions: (T,) or (T, D_action) float32
    ├── rewards: (T,) float32
    ├── success: (T,) bool
    └── ...
```

## Key Data Fields

### sensor_data (raw images)
- **rgb**: `(T, H, W, 3) uint8`, range [0, 255]
- **depth**: `(T, H, W, 1) int16`, depth in millimeters
- **position**: `(T, H, W, 3) int16`, camera-space XYZ coordinates in mm
- **segmentation**: `(T, H, W, 1) int16`, actor IDs

### pointcloud (full)
- **xyzw**: `(T, N, 4) float32`
  - xyz: world coordinates in meters, typical range [-10.0, 10.0]
  - w: foreground flag (0.0 or 1.0)
- **rgb**: `(T, N, 3) uint8`, range [0, 255]
- **segmentation**: `(T, N, 1) int16`
- N = H × W (all pixels from all cameras)

### pointcloud/xyzrgb (cropped & sampled)
- **Shape**: `(T, 1024, 6) float32`
- **Format**: `[x, y, z, r, g, b]`
- **Cropping**: centered at robot base_pose, box size:
  - x: [-1.5, +1.5] m
  - y: [-1.5, +1.5] m
  - z: [0.0, +3.0] m
- **Sampling**: random downsample/upsample to exactly 1024 points
- **xyz**: world coordinates in meters, range ~[-2.0, 2.0]
- **rgb**: normalized float [0.0, 1.0] (uint8 / 255.0)
- **Foreground only**: background points excluded

## Typical Values

| Field | Shape | Dtype | Range | Notes |
|-------|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| rgb | (T, H, W, 3) | uint8 | [0, 255] | Raw image |
| depth | (T, H, W, 1) | int16 | [0, ~5000] | Millimeters |
| xyzw | (T, N, 4) | float32 | xyz: scene, w: {0,1} | Full pointcloud |
| xyzrgb | (T, 1024, 6) | float32 | xyz: [-2,2], rgb: [0,1] | Cropped 1024pts |
| base_pose | (T, 7) | float32 | position: scene | Robot base |

T = trajectory length, H = image height, W = image width, N = H×W×num_cameras
